question: Can you identify a thai restaurant within 190 kilometers of City Suites Hotel, Chicago, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE cuisine ILIKE '%thai%' AND restaurant IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%City Suites Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1), 190000);
